signin.heading: Sign in to OpsTrack
signin.subtitle: Accounts are created by your admin. Sign in with the username you were given, or with your email address.
signin.identifierHint: Your username, or the email your account was created with.
signin.linkSent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device and you're in.
signin.linkHint: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. If it hasn't arrived after a minute, check your spam folder.
signin.linkResent: A new link is on its way.
signin.codeDisclosureHint: If your email contained a 6-digit code rather than a link, type it here.
signin.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
signin.errEmailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
signin.errNoAccount: No account with that email — accounts are created by the admin. Check the address or ask for an invite.
signin.errCodeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
signin.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
signin.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
signin.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
signin.notConfigured: This build has no backend configured, so sign-in is unavailable.
signin.firstTime: First time here? Claim your account
signin.claimSubtitle: Enter the username and invite code your admin gave you, then choose a password.
signin.useEmail: Sign in with an email code instead
signin.useUsername: Sign in with a username instead
signin.errInviteRequired: Enter the invite code your admin gave you.
signin.errInviteInvalid: That invite code is wrong or has already been used. Ask your admin to reissue one.
signin.errAlreadyClaimed: This account has already been claimed. Sign in with your password, or ask your admin to reset it.
